id: # The weapons of weapons-and-production.md (manual p.12; guide book p.9). One row for each weapon that 生產兵裝 produces.
# cost: documented. The gold of one production command; a specialty city pays produce.specialty_percent of it (assumed, Q-022).
# facility: the effect of the facility that produces it: weapons (smithy), horses (stable), siege (workshop), ships (shipyard).
# specialty: the city specialty that makes it cheaper (documented, guide book p.9).
# stock: the index into the weapon stocks of a city (save-file.md, city +32). The order of the siege and ship stocks is assumed (Q-006, Q-156).
# min_days, max_days: 0 for weapons that arrive at once; 30 to 90 days for siege weapons and ships (documented).
# needs_technique: the weapon needs a technique; the techniques come in M4, so these rows always refuse.
